scope: Java 8 MES authentication adapter unit and proxy contract acceptance

items.evidence: companyId, approved legacy role, plant and line were mapped into a bounded BPI actor.
An authenticated subject without an explicit server-side scope was denied.
Java 8 compatible role-rules and subject-scope-rules were parsed into the approved role and line scope maps.
HS256 signature, issuer, audience, tenant claim and 10-minute expiry were verified with Nimbus.

Only approved BPI reads and commands were allowed, including shadow-run create/start/review/complete/approve/reject/cancel; delete, export, arbitrary subpaths, method changes and path traversal were denied.
Candidate/batch and shadow-run proxy tests replaced the legacy bearer, kept the fixed BPI upstream, forwarded query/body plus Idempotency-Key and If-Match, and ignored browser-owned scope headers.

runtimeSmoke.unauthenticatedBpiApi: HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate Bearer and no Set-Cookie/JSESSIONID
runtimeSmoke.configuration: Non-secret local acceptance values; the JWKS URL was intentionally unreachable and no authenticated request was claimed.

limitations: No live Keycloak JWKS request or real MES login token was used in this unit acceptance.
Docker Compose rendered successfully; the adapter container image and healthcheck were not runtime-tested.
The explicit admin/PLANT-01/LINE-S07-01 mapping is a test-environment default and must be replaced by reviewed production scope configuration.
The internal token still uses the Phase 1 shared HS256 key; asymmetric signing and rotation remain pending.
